moisture_pct.note: IFCT E026 seedless round green 85.55+/-1.70; range spans IFCT Vitis vinifera entries E022-E027 (black seedless oval 75.30)

water_activity.note: From berry highest freezing point -3.0 C (AH-66) / -2.7 C (Cantwell 2001) via ln aw = -0.00969*dTf (Chirife & Fontan 1982) = 0.971-0.974

respiration.note: AH-66 chapter (berries + stems): 2-4 (0 C), 6-8 (5 C), 10-16 (10 C), 24-30 (20 C); stem respiration ~15x berry. Ea fitted by Arrhenius to midpoints

storage_optimum.note: AH-66: -1 to 0 C, 90-95% RH, marketed up to 8-10 weeks with SO2 fumigation/pads. Life range 1-6 months from Cantwell 2001; strongly cultivar- and SO2-dependent - without SO2 decay control expect the low end or less

ethylene.note: <0.1 uL/kg.h at 20 C; not very sensitive to ethylene; non-climacteric; not chilling sensitive

cut.note: respiration_x from KB generic mod_cut (USDA-AH66); 4 h = FDA Food Code 3-501.19 time-as-control limit
